principle_violations.reason: The Order class has multiple responsibilities: managing order items and their details, as well as handling order status. These should be separated into distinct classes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a separate class such as OrderItem to encapsulate item details and manage them independently from the order state management.

principle_violations.reason: All payment processors repeat the code structure for processing payments and setting order status. This leads to code duplication across classes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a base class or an abstract class for payment processing that encapsulates common functionality and allows each processor to define specific behavior.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
